assessment.nobel_worthiness: A fundamental physiological insight has enabled transformative treatment of diabetes and obesity at population scale.
assessment.attribution: Holst, Mojsov, and Drucker represent pivotal physiological, molecular, and translational contributions to the GLP-1 field.
assessment.maturity: The mechanism and therapeutic consequences have been extensively confirmed through long-term clinical use.
uncertainties: The appropriate balance between foundational GLP-1 discovery and subsequent therapeutic development remains difficult to delimit.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: cGAS-STING provided a major conceptual account of how cytosolic DNA elicits innate immune responses, with broad implications for infection, autoimmunity, and cancer.
assessment.attribution: Chen, Ishikawa, and Sun have especially direct links to identification and mechanistic establishment of the pathway.
assessment.maturity: The pathway is firmly established across experimental systems and has generated extensive disease-directed research.
uncertainties: Clinical translation of pathway modulation remains less settled than the foundational biology.
Several investigators made important interconnected contributions to cGAS and STING biology.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Antisense correction of SMN2 splicing converted a mechanistic RNA insight into a highly consequential treatment for spinal muscular atrophy.
assessment.attribution: Krainer and Bennett provide a compact and credible pairing of splicing mechanism and therapeutic antisense development.
assessment.maturity: Clinical efficacy and sustained real-world implementation make the advance mature.
uncertainties: The contribution of broader clinical-development teams cannot be fully represented by two names.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: CAR-T cells established a new therapeutic modality capable of producing deep remissions in otherwise refractory cancers.
assessment.attribution: June, Sadelain, and Rosenberg represent major complementary contributions to engineered cellular immunotherapy and its clinical realization.
assessment.maturity: The principle is clinically validated, approved across multiple hematologic cancers, and continues to extend.
uncertainties: Durable efficacy remains uneven across malignancies, particularly solid tumors.
The field has broad and distributed technical attribution.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Chaperonin-assisted folding decisively changed understanding of how cells achieve functional protein structure.
assessment.attribution: Horwich and Hartl are directly and appropriately associated with the central discovery.
assessment.maturity: The mechanistic framework has been repeatedly confirmed and has enduring influence in cell biology and disease research.
uncertainties: The candidate description emphasizes one important class of chaperones within a wider proteostasis field.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The unfolded protein response revealed a fundamental signaling system coupling organelle stress to cellular adaptation.
assessment.attribution: Mori and Walter have strong, complementary claims for establishing core branches and mechanisms of the response.
assessment.maturity: The framework is deeply replicated and central to modern understanding of proteostasis and secretory-cell physiology.
uncertainties: Its disease-directed therapeutic impact is still less definitive than its basic biological importance.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: TNF blockade demonstrated that rational targeting of a cytokine could transform treatment of rheumatoid arthritis and inflammatory disease.
assessment.attribution: Feldmann and Maini jointly link the pathogenic cytokine rationale to decisive clinical proof of principle.
assessment.maturity: Its therapeutic benefit, reproducibility, and broad clinical adoption are long established.
uncertainties: TNF biology and anti-TNF drug development involved substantial contributions beyond the proposed pair.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Massively parallel sequencing made genome-scale investigation practical and reshaped biomedical research, diagnosis, and precision medicine.
assessment.attribution: Klenerman, Mayer, and Balasubramanian have identifiable foundational roles in key sequencing-platform innovations.
assessment.maturity: The technological and biomedical impact is extensive and sustained across research and clinical applications.
uncertainties: Multiple technically distinct sequencing approaches and contributors complicate attribution to a single discovery.
